product.name: Replacement Water Purification and Filtration Cartridges for the GeoPress and UltraPress Filtration Systems
product.description: Cylindrical replacement filter units inserted into a rigid outer bottle to remove submicron biological, chemical, and particulate contaminants. Each cartridge houses a proprietary non-woven electro-adsorptive filter media encased in polypropylene plastic end caps with two silicone O-rings.

operations.name: Perform melt-blown fiber extrusion to create high-aspect-ratio alumina/glass continuous fibers
Blend slurry with cellulose pulp and activated carbon fibers in a precise weight ratio
Form web on a flat wire fourdrinier paper machine to produce a uniform composite
Laminate multiple fiber layers under heat, tension, and time controls
Treat surface with proprietary compounds to increase electropositive charge density
Cut filter media and perform quality control testing and bio-testing
Produce polypropylene plastic end caps and silicone O-rings
Pleat U.S.-origin filter media into cylindrical form and hot-seal into pleat packs
Insert pleat packs into polypropylene plastic end caps, glue, and cure
Affix two silicone O-rings to complete the cartridge
